county_relationship.note: Counties derived from the county on each facility's source record. A ZIP can span several counties; HUD USPS crosswalk not yet configured.

top_violation_types.title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Two infants did not have current infant feeding schedules.

top_violation_types.title: Parental Notification of Less Serious Injuries (26 TAC §746.307(c))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation is not notifying parents of less serious injuries.

top_violation_types.title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation knowingly allowed persons to be present at the operation before receiving notification from the CBCU that the persons eligibility determination is Eligible, Provisional or Eligible with Conditions.

top_violation_types.title: Fenced Outdoor Activity Space -Exits Required (26 TAC §746.4307)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: On the infant/toddler playground they is only one exit, the fence area needs another exit.

top_violation_types.title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One child's file was missing a health statement.

top_violation_types.title: Director Responsibilities - Employee Assignments (26 TAC §746.1003(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The director assigned a caregiver assignments that did not match their skills, abilities, and training.

top_violation_types.title: Release of Children (26 TAC §746.4101)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: According to investigation findings, the operation did not follow court orders on file when releasing a child in care.

top_violation_types.title: AP Parental Communication - Injury Requires Treatment by Health Care Professional or Hospitalization (26 TAC §746.307(b)(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Staff did not notify the parents of a child who received an injury while in care.
